newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin signs decree regulating natural monopolies.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin signs decree regulating natural monopolies.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin signed a decree on regulating natural monopolies on Monday, Interfax news agency said.
It said he had also signed a decree on housing reform and that First Deputy Prime Minister Boris Nemtsov would hold a news conference at 1 p.m. (0900 GMT) giving further details of the decrees.

Nemtsov, one of a number of reformers recently appointed to the cabinet in a government shake-up, is in charge of reforming natural monopolies, large companies with no competition such as natural gas producer Gazprom GAZP.RTS and the railroads.
The presidential press service was unable to immediately confirm Yeltsin had signed the decrees.
